info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Ecommerce Cart Merge-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Merge API enables businesses to consolidate multiple shopping carts into a single unified cart, ensuring a seamless and efficient shopping experience. This functionality is essential for improving customer satisfaction by allowing users to combine items from different carts before checkout. Typical consumers include ecommerce platforms and retailers looking to enhance their cart management capabilities. The API leverages robust operations to support the merging process, optimizing inventory handling and order processing.

put.summary: Merge items from multiple carts into a single cart.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to merge items from different carts into one unified cart. It helps streamline the shopping experience by consolidating products across various carts, making it easier to manage your selections.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to merge cart items, allowing the client to combine items from different carts into a single one. Ensure that the payload conforms to the specified schema to prevent errors during the merging process.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the carts have been merged.
